mods.summary: Shiny DV rolls, Gen 2 recolors, and sparkles in battle/overworld; rates and toggles under OPTIONS → SHINY POKEMON.

mods.title: Special Stat Split
mods.author: ZyranCZ
mods.summary: Splits SPECIAL into SPATK and SPDEF (Gen II+) and moves into physical/special categories (Gen IV+).

mods.title: Species Rebalance
mods.author: Gilles93
mods.summary: Rebalances base stats of Pokémon species.

mods.title: Stadium Battle FX
mods.author: anxiousintrovert
mods.summary: Pokémon Stadium-style battle move effects extracted from the player's own cartridge data.

mods.title: Stadium Model Viewer for Pokédex
mods.author: randyadr
mods.summary: 3D model viewer integrated into the Pokédex.

mods.title: Stereo & 5.1 Audio
mods.author: ShaneMcGovernIE
mods.summary: Pokémon Crystal's SOUND option, ported to Red/Blue/Yellow's 8-bit music: MONO, STEREO channel split, and 5.1 surround with center-channel sound effects.

mods.title: Stronger Trainers
mods.author: Gilles93
mods.summary: Increases the strength and challenge of trainer battles.

mods.title: Summon
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Adds a SUMMON menu that starts a normal wild encounter using a Pokédex number.

mods.title: Switch Advisor
mods.author: allanrmartins
mods.summary: Grades every party mon against the foe on the battle switch screen, and skips the nickname prompt on capture.

mods.title: Team Rocket Returns
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A story quest in which Team Rocket resurfaces for a new series of battles and events.

mods.title: Terrarium
mods.author: BrenoBertucci
mods.summary: Independent fork of DramaticShape's 3D voxel diorama: own id, folder, pipelines and letter hotkeys; installs beside DRAMATIC_SHAPE.

mods.title: The Abandoned Cabin
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A Thunder Badge quest involving strange lights, Route 11 and an abandoned cabin.

mods.title: The Black Flower
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Help Erika cleanse a corrupted secret garden, survive black spores and defeat a possessed Victreebel.

mods.title: The Empty Throne
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A late-game quest built around an absent ruler, new encounters and a hidden threat.

mods.title: The Mirage of Mew
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A post-Earth Badge adventure across Pokémon Mansion, Pokémon Tower, Viridian Forest and Seafoam Islands, culminating in a repeatable Mew encounter.

mods.title: The Sixth Bell
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A supernatural Lavender Town and Pokémon Tower quest unlocked after obtaining six Badges.

mods.title: The Stolen Fossil
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Investigate a museum theft after the Boulder Badge and recover a fossil from Mt. Moon.

mods.title: The Three-Stone Covenant
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A multi-stage quest featuring Electric, Water and Fire trials, ending with Eevee's evolutions as rewards.

mods.title: Toast Notifications
mods.author: dburton95
mods.summary: Displays toast-style notifications in-game.

mods.title: Trade Evolution Fix
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Replaces Generation I trade evolutions with level-40 evolutions.

mods.title: Traducción Española
mods.author: jherediagu
mods.summary: El juego en español desde tu propio cartucho EUR — guion oficial, sin redistribuir nada

mods.title: Traduction FR étendue
mods.author: AntoniMan31
mods.summary: Complète la traduction française de translation-fr : 151 catégories du Pokédex, 109 textes moteur et 11 noms manquants. Nécessite translation-fr.

mods.title: Traduction Québécoise
mods.author: MrJoufflu
mods.summary: Traduction complète en français québécois (joual + sacres ciblés) pour Pokémon Rouge, Bleu et Jaune, basée sur le texte français officiel.

mods.title: Trainer Rematch
mods.author: ShaneMcGovernIE
mods.summary: Talk to any trainer you have already beaten and they challenge you to a rematch, with a YES/NO prompt.

mods.title: Trainers Let You Choose Lead Pokemon
mods.author: ZyranCZ
mods.summary: Lets you choose which party Pokémon to send out first against trainers instead of always using the first slot.

mods.title: Typed Move Colors
mods.author: piftee
mods.summary: Type-coloured move buttons in battles and menus.

mods.title: Unique Menu Icons
mods.author: menyas
mods.summary: Gives every Gen 1 Pokemon its own unique party/menu icon instead of the vanilla shared body-type icons.

mods.title: Universal Free TM Shop
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Adds a dedicated free TM Shop to every Poke Mart. Clerks offer the normal shop or a separate catalogue containing all Generation I TMs at no cost.

mods.title: Useful Bag
mods.author: ShaneMcGovernIE
mods.summary: 999-capacity bag auto-sorted into six pockets (Items, Medicine, Poké Balls, TMs / HMs, Battle Items, Key Items) cycled with Left/Right, plus TAB / R3 to sort by name or count.

mods.title: Useful Dex
mods.author: ShaneMcGovernIE
mods.summary: Press A in the Pokédex to cycle the species page into base stats, BST, evolutions, and the full movelist.

mods.title: Useful Marts
mods.author: ShaneMcGovernIE
mods.summary: Mart lists with useful info: BUY rows show how many of each item you already have (live), SELL rows show the per-item sell price, and both lists wrap at the ends.

mods.title: Useful Move Info
mods.author: ShaneMcGovernIE
mods.summary: In battle, press Start (or Q) on a highlighted move to see type, power, accuracy, effect and type effectiveness; the same shortcut inspects moves when learning one.

mods.title: VersãoVermelha
mods.author: bryanthaboi
mods.summary: Português brasileiro, ripped from the Hyd~Traduções Versão Vermelha v1.3.1 IPS patch.

mods.title: Voxel 3D Pokedex
mods.author: DavidSchuchert
mods.summary: The Pokedex entry page as a voxel clamshell device that folds open around a rotating Stadium 3D model of the Pokemon.

mods.title: Voxel Characters
mods.author: last-swagger
mods.summary: Extrudes Gen1Recomp overworld character sprites into voxel slabs. Companion for Dramatic Shape Voxel Mod.

mods.title: Whispers Beneath Cerulean
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Explore contaminated canals beneath Cerulean City after the Cascade Badge and rescue a powerful Starmie.

mods.title: Who's That Trainer?
mods.author: MyFriendDevBR
mods.summary: Inject your own custom sprites or play as Gym Leaders, Elite 4, and Rivals.

mods.title: Widescreen Battle Intro
mods.author: ShaneMcGovernIE
mods.summary: Extends the battle-intro flash across the full window on widescreen displays, instead of a centered 160x144 square.

mods.title: Wild Skies
mods.author: ShaneHudson
mods.summary: Flying Pokémon from the encounter tables cross the overworld.

mods.title: Wilds of Kanto
mods.author: YoDrehDenSwagAuf
mods.summary: Visible and reactive wild Pokemon for the Gen 1 overworld

mods.title: Yellow Legacy Changes
mods.author: ShaneMcGovernIE
mods.summary: Applies the move and stat rebalances from Yellow Legacy by TSP: buffed/nerfed moves, new types and effects, rebalanced base stats.
